description: Linear regression of y ~ x for one entity. Returns slope, intercept, R² and interpretation. Use for "how does X predict Y?" questions. Runs on any verified autario indicator (World Bank, FRED, Eurostat, OECD, IMF, WHO, ECB, US Census, SEC).

entity.description: Entity the series is read for: an ISO 3166 alpha-3 country code such as "DEU" or "USA", or an aggregate code such as "WLD" or "EUU" (the canonical name matches too). Use the codes list_indicators and get_entity_profile accept.

full.description: Return the full raw time series (heavy, many tokens). Default false → you get only the summary/stats, which is enough to ANSWER a question. Set true only when you must plot or export every point.

time.description: Optional time window. "2010-2023" keeps 2010 through 2023, "2019-01-2024-06" works by month, and a single "2015" keeps 2015 onward. Omitted or unparseable = the whole series.

name: regression
